_comment: Commented example of the fleet-monitor configuration, with Codex as the orchestrator. Copy it to fleet-monitor.config.json (next to server.mjs) and edit the paths for this PC. Relative paths resolve against the folder of this file. %VARS% and the ~ prefix are expanded.

server._comment: The server only binds loopback; a non-loopback host is forced back to 127.0.0.1.

orchestrator._comment: engine: claude-code | codex | opencode. Its usage meter is shown first on the page. The header reads ORQUESTADOR: <model> · <effort>.
orchestrator.label: Codex

workers._comment: Tracks are read from the autopilot kit config; only board:true tracks are shown, groups collapse like board.ps1.

claude._comment: claude-usage.json shape: { time, fiveHour, weekly, resetsAt }. Optional: without it the Claude meter reports sin datos.

codex._comment: Codex 5 h / weekly limits are read from today's rollout files here (same search as board.ps1 Get-CodexLimits).

opencode._comment: The official snapshot wins; the estimate script is the fallback and also measures the local spend since the snapshot. Both are optional.

translate._comment: Spanish display layer: commit subjects and per-builder activity summaries are translated by a free OpenCode model through the shared server (helperExe and server come from kit.config.json). enabled false turns it off; summarySeconds is the minimum gap between summaries per builder. The cache is translations.json next to server.mjs (git-ignored).

cleanup._comment: Oculta del tablero las tarjetas terminadas o detenidas cuyo último estado sea más viejo que estos minutos (5 por defecto). El encabezado de agentes permite mostrarlas de nuevo. 0 o la clave ausente desactivan la limpieza.
